description: This file defines the class I18NImportErrorDecorator which provides methods to modify and manage I18NImportError entities, including setting related language, error, and employee references.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for I18NImportError entity to facilitate setting related foreign key references such as language, error, and employee.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the decorator with an I18NImportError entity.

methods.name: setImportError
methods.description: Sets the I18NImportError entity to a new instance.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Sets the language string reference for the import error by its ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Sets the language reference for the import error by language ID.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Sets the error reference for the import error by error name.

methods.name: setImportedEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the imported employee reference for the import error by employee number.
